about: Reference vectors for app/compression/mcotxt.py, produced by HDDen/meshcore-open's own Dart MCOtxt implementation (lib/MCOtxt, lib/helpers/mcotxt_app_codec.dart, commit 4a669f7). 'stream'/'bits' were encoded with the default language pair (a, b) set to the one RemoteTerm picks; 'searchStream'/'searchBits' with the reference's full pair search; 'mct' is encodeTextTransport(text, timestamp: 0); 'roomBody' is encodeBody(text, timestamp 1700000000, sender 'Alice', reply to 'Bob' at 1699999999); 'decoded' is the normalised text every decode must return.
